issues.title: Support Panel - create new orders
issues.body:
The Support Panel has an orders tab:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/190681556-8e6e3470-d758-4eaf-b450-648648a62d26.png)


The tab currently shows a list of templates for that set of orders.  We should allow players to create new orders.  The "New orders" will be shown as a drop-down list, that the user clicks to indicate what type of document to create. ( Hopefully we can re-use the implementation in "New Message", now that it has been refactored):
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/190681988-13636277-5b41-44d1-a170-b907bdba4aad.png)

See the `Blue & SME` tab here: https://serge-review.herokuapp.com/?wargame=wargame-kskl1i3t&access=pkskl17ti

comments.body: it would be good if we place this component at the bottom of the support panel (in Order tab) ? @IanMayo

Thanks for that @lebaphi 

If NewMessage needs those props in order to send messages (with all the correct metadata), then I think we have to provide those props.

I'll try to have a look at the code this morning, and give you an answer.
Yes, at the bottom of the Orders tab in support.  We do have something similar at the bottom of the `CollabStatusPanel` - but I don't know if that allows multiple templates.
